Continuity notes

Every scene has a script supervisor's fingerprint on it — the eyeline that matches, the prop that stays in the right hand, the line that was actually said. I've spent more than 5,500 hours keeping that thread unbroken, from indie features to national ad campaigns, working alongside more than 50 directors since 2011.

Based on the East Coast and bilingual in English and Spanish, available to travel for productions across the U.S.

Between 2024 and 2026, I stepped away from features and commercials to study artificial intelligence and programming. I'm back on set now, bringing that same discipline for detail and process back into script supervision.
